import json
import subprocess
import sys

    sys.executable, "-m", "json.tool"
], input=json.dumps({
    "repo": "re-cinq/HALEngine",
    "branch": "loop-bench/95"
}).encode(), capture_output=True, text=True)

    print("Error:", result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print(result.stdout)
